## Project Manager: Make a Status Update Clearer

Canonical: https://edooqoo.com/what-to-teach-next/project-manager-status-update

### Newsletter
A B2 project manager can report completed work but loses control when explaining delays and dependencies. The evidence-led decision is **Continue**: The core reporting skill is present, but the learner still needs support to explain cause, impact, and next action as one coherent update. Read the full constructed case: https://edooqoo.com/what-to-teach-next/project-manager-status-update

In this constructed adult 1:1 case, the learner reports completed tasks accurately in a prepared update. The decision is Continue. Full reasoning and lesson sequence: https://edooqoo.com/what-to-teach-next/project-manager-status-update

### 60-second video script
Hook: What should this tutor teach next? Context: A B2 project manager leads a weekly remote status meeting with an international product team. The immediate goal is to explain progress, dependencies, and risk without reading a script. Evidence: The learner reports completed tasks accurately in a prepared update. When a dependency causes a delay, the learner switches to vague phrases such as "there is a problem". Homework used because and so correctly, but did not distinguish cause, consequence, and mitigation. Decision: Continue. Why: The core reporting skill is present, but the learner still needs support to explain cause, impact, and next action as one coherent update. Next objective: By the end of the lesson, the learner will deliver a 60-second status update that states a dependency, its impact, and one mitigation action without a written script. This is a worked example, not a real student result. Full case: https://edooqoo.com/what-to-teach-next/project-manager-status-update
